message.content: In the conversation between LiHua and Chae, LiHua offers several tips on balancing work and personal hobbies. Specifically, LiHua emphasizes the importance of training pets with leashes to ensure safety and better control over the animals. He explains that a leash can help prevent dogs from jumping on people, which can be problematic, and it also aids in training the pets for better behavior. Additionally, LiHua points out the convenience of having a leash while walking in crowded areas, as it keeps the dog and others calm and helps to manage the pet's curiosity. LiHua also mentions the peace of mind a leash provides, especially in crowded places. These suggestions highlight his approach to integrating personal hobbies (dog walking) with professional responsibilities (training and maintaining order).
